_about: Public-domain Samuel Walker of Truro (1714-1761), Cornish evangelical, for the Word Hoard: Christ the Purifier (London 1817), The Christian, a course of practical sermons (Glasgow 1825), and Fifty-two Lectures on the Church Catechism (London 1836), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 43 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
